ai:аблакат.note: Dialectal/nonstandard spelling of адвокат, used in the folk saying 'аблакат – нанятая совесть' (a hired conscience).

ai:автодафе.note: From Portuguese auto da fé, an Inquisition ceremony where heretics were sentenced and burned; used in the Grand Inquisitor legend.

ai:адвокатишка.note: Pejorative diminutive of адвокат; text has genitive plural адвокатишек.

ai:ажно.note: Colloquial/dialectal variant of аж (even, so that).

ai:ажный.note: Wrong headword; the form is ажно, a colloquial variant of аж.

ai:ай-люли.note: Colloquial refrain from folk songs, here used mockingly for 'and so on, nonsense'.

ai:акриды.note: Church Slavonic/biblical word (акрида); the food of John the Baptist in the wilderness.

ai:акриды-то.note: Form of акриды with the particle -то; see акрида (locust, biblical food of hermits).

ai:ананасный.note: Adjective from ананас; 'ананасный компот' means pineapple compote.

ai:ангел-барышня.note: Ironic/effusive form of address used by Grushenka toward Katerina Ivanovna.

ai:антидорцу.note: Dative of антидор/антидорец; the blessed bread distributed after liturgy. Here it means a mere crumb of food.

ai:аплодисмент.note: Singular form of аплодисменты, which is normally plural; here a single burst of applause.

ai:апокрифический.note: Refers to non-canonical religious texts; here the apocryphal Gospels.

ai:артистическа.note: Misspelled headword; the correct form is артистически, from артистический.

ai:артистически.note: Used here ironically of human cruelty.

ai:архиподлец.note: Formed with the intensifying prefix архи-; the text has it in the nominative singular.

ai:архитриклиновить.note: Wrong headword; the form архитриклинови is the Church Slavonic dative of архитриклин (master of the feast), from the wedding at Cana quote.

ai:архитриклиновь.note: Wrong headword; the correct lemma is архитриклин. Church Slavonic dative архитриклинови, from the Gospel of John (Cana).

ai:архиультрамонтанство.note: Coined with архи- from ультрамонтанство (ultramontanism, extreme support for papal authority).

ai:аршинный.note: From аршин, an old measure of about 71 cm; 'аршинными шагами' means with long, striding steps.

ai:бабусенька.note: Affectionate diminutive of бабуся/бабушка; here fondly applied to Russia.

ai:байроновский.note: From Byron, the English poet, whose heroes are proud, brooding rebels.

ai:бакалейный.note: Used in 'бакалейный магазин', a grocery shop selling dry goods.

ai:бальзамчик.note: Diminutive of бальзам; here a medicinal or herbal liqueur.

ai:банкер.note: The bank-holder in a gambling game; here in the mouth of the Poles' card scene.

ai:бардзо.note: Polish (bardzo); used in the speech of the Polish characters.

ai:бардзый.note: Wrong headword; the form is Polish bardzo (very), spoken by the Polish characters.

ai:бариновый.note: Possessive adjective from барин, colloquial; here 'the master's trust'.

ai:барчонок.note: Diminutive of барин (gentleman), a young son of the gentry; often slightly derogatory.

ai:барынька.note: Diminutive of барыня (lady, mistress); tone varies from fondness to mild contempt.

ai:баснословие.note: Dated bookish word for myths and fables.

ai:баш.note: From Turkic baş (head); 'баш на баш' is a colloquial idiom meaning an even exchange.

ai:бе.note: Church Slavonic imperfect of быти ('to be'), as in Gospel quotations like 'и бе мати Иисусова ту'.

ai:беглянка.note: Feminine of беглец; here a woman who ran away from home.

ai:безбожество.note: Rare/dated; text has dative безбожеству ('to his godlessness').

ai:безвинный-с.note: безвинны-с: the servile particle -с (from сударь) is added, as Smerdyakov speaks; base word безвинный

ai:безвременный.note: in the Fyodor Pavlovich quote, безвременном is used loosely (roughly 'decrepit, out of time'); a stretched, unusual usage

ai:безответность.note: here: not answering back, passive meekness

ai:безотлучный.note: text form безотлучно is an adverb: 'without leaving, constantly at one's side'

ai:безотчетность.note: безотчетность is the ё-less spelling; describes feelings one cannot account for

ai:безудерж.note: variant of безудержность; in the phrase 'karamazovian безудерж' = reckless lack of restraint

ai:безудержать.note: the analyzer's headword is wrong; безудержу is the genitive of the noun безудерж ('unrestraint, impetuosity')

ai:безурядица.note: dated/literary; here: the disorder of Russia

ai:безыскусственный.note: text form безыскусствен is the short form; безыскусственно is the adverb

g: idle landowner who avoids manual labor
ai:белоручек-помещик.note: the correct lemma is белоручка (person who avoids manual work) + помещик (landowner); plural genitive белоручек-помещиков

g: idle landowner who avoids manual labor
ai:белоручка-помещик.note: белоручка = person who shuns manual labor, a dandy/idler; помещик = landowner; genitive plural форма белоручек-помещиков

ai:бельишечко.note: affectionate double diminutive of бельё (linen, underwear); dialect/folk speech

ai:беснование.note: here: the possessed fits of the klikushi (hysterical women believed possessed)

ai:бесова.note: possessive adjective from бес (demon), feminine/genitive form used in folk speech; бесова сына = 'devil's son'

ai:бесцензурность.note: unusual coinage; here: speaking without any propriety or restraint

ai:бечева.note: used for hauling barges (бечевою тянуть = to tow by rope, by burlak)

ai:бечевой.note: headword is wrong; the form бечевою is the instrumental of бечева (towline, tow rope), used to tow barges

ai:бечевочка.note: diminutive of бечёвка (string); text spelling бечевочки without ё

ai:биллиардный.note: old spelling of бильярдный; биллиардной is used as a noun = billiard room

ai:биющий-то.note: Dialectal/archaic participle of бить ('биющих' = бьющих), a quoted phrase 'бьющих на чувствительность' = playing for sympathy. Lemma is odd; correct lemma is бьющий.

ai:благовестить.note: Church Slavonic-flavored; originally 'to announce good news'.

ai:благовестный.note: 'Благовестный звон' = the bell ringing calling to service; derived from благовест.

g: to be in a placid, good-humored mood
ai:благодушествовать.note: Somewhat bookish; here of a drunkard-in-the-making being genially contented.

ai:благонравный.note: Form 'благонравно' is the adverb; used ironically here.

ai:благословишисить.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong. Text has 'благословишися' = Church Slavonic imperative/subjunctive form of благословитися ('be blessed'); part of a ritual formula 'Благословляя да благословишися'.

ai:благочиние.note: Also a church term (supervision of parishes), but here means propriety, order.

ai:блажной-с.note: Form 'блажные-с' = plural of блажной with servile particle -с (Smerdyakov's speech style).

ai:блудилище.note: Archaic/bookish word for a house of ill repute.

ai:бо.note: Church Slavonic conjunction (as in Bible quotations).

ai:богадельный.note: From богадельня (almshouse); 'дом богадельный' = a home like an almshouse.

ai:боговидица.note: Church Slavonic-style epithet, here of St. Mary of Egypt; feminine of боговидец.

ai:богомолье.note: Trip to holy places to pray.

ai:богомольный.note: Also used of pilgrims; 'богомольные старушки' = devout old women.

ai:богопочтение.note: Archaic/poetic; genitive-like form 'богопочтенья' appears in a quoted verse.

g: to put on a brave, cheerful face

ai:бозить.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong: 'бози' is Church Slavonic plural of 'бог' (gods), from the biblical 'яко бози' = 'like gods'.

ai:бозь.note: Wrong lemma: 'бози' is Church Slavonic nominative plural of бог; from Genesis 'яко бози' ('as gods').

ai:болезние.note: Archaic/wrong lemma: 'болезнию' = instrumental of болезнь; 'за болезнию' = on account of illness (old form of the case ending).

ai:болоночко.note: Wrong lemma: correct is болоночка (feminine), a diminutive of болонка (lapdog).

ai:борать.note: Wrong lemma: 'борет' is colloquial/dialectal 3rd person of бороть/бороться... correct form is бороть ('to fight'); 'себя борет' = fights herself, restrains herself.

ai:бороть.note: Older/colloquial form of побороть/одолевать; 'себя борет' = struggles with herself.

ai:бременить.note: Archaic; 'не бременить землю' = not to burden the earth (with one's existence).

ai:брыкливость.note: From брыкливый (prone to kick/buck); here his refractory conduct.

ai:бульонщик.note: Contemptuous nickname/insult, meaning one who makes broth (e.g. cook); appears as Grigory's insult to Smerdyakov.

ai:бухнуться.note: Colloquial; 'бухнуться в ноги' = fall at someone's feet.

ai:быдто.note: Dialectal/colloquial form of 'будто'; here used as an ironic 'as if you don't know'.

ai:быдтый.note: Wrong headword; the text form is just the colloquial particle 'быдто' (= будто).

ai:бысть.note: Church Slavonic aorist of быти (to be); archaic. Not a modern Russian word.

ai:вакация.note: Dated word from Latin 'vacatio'; used of school/university holidays (usually plural 'вакации').

ai:валаамов.note: Possessive adjective of Валаам (Balaam); 'валаамова ослица' is Balaam's ass, the talking donkey of the Bible (Numbers 22).

ai:ввернуть.note: Here: to interject a remark into conversation. Forms ввернул/ввернуто are past tense/participle.

ai:ввертывать.note: Imperfective of ввернуть; here: inserting the banknotes into the envelope.

ai:вдовица.note: Archaic/literary or Church Slavonic-flavored word for вдова.

ai:вдовый.note: Dated; said of a man whose wife has died (widower).

ai:велено.note: Impersonal passive of велеть (to order): 'it was ordered that'.

ai:великодушничать.note: Colloquial, often ironic: to put on generosity/magnanimity toward someone.

ai:великомученический.note: From великомученик (great martyr); here: a cross/burden of martyr-like suffering.

ai:велице.note: Church Slavonic adverb; here the form 'велицем' belongs to велий (great), as in 'великая четверток'. Archaic.

ai:велицый.note: Church Slavonic form (= великий); 'о велицем четвертке' refers to Great (Holy) Thursday. Archaic.

ai:вервие.note: Church Slavonic/archaic; here the rope belt of a monk's cassock.

ai:верзиться.note: Dialectal/colloquial spelling; 'верзись вниз' = 'throw yourself down' (from the Temptation of Christ). Likely a form of 'ввергнуться/ввергаться' or 'верзиться' in older usage.

ai:верниссимо.note: Jocular Italianate superlative of 'верно' (correct), used playfully.

ai:версточка.note: Diminutive of верста (verst, about 1.07 km); 'версточек' is genitive plural, used to make the distance seem short.

ai:верстушка.note: Affectionate diminutive of верста (verst); used to minimize the distance.

ai:верстушко.note: Wrong headword; the text form 'верстушка' is a diminutive of верста (verst).

ai:веруесать.note: Wrong headword; 'веруеши' is Church Slavonic 2nd person singular of веровати ('како веруеши' = how do you believe). Archaic.

ai:взвар.note: Old Russian dish: a drink/stewed fruit boiled with honey, common in monastic fare.

ai:взлезть.note: Colloquial; here: to climb onto the cart.

ai:взмоститься.note: Colloquial/dated; 'взмостясь' is the gerund, 'having climbed up onto something'.

ai:взрасти.note: Archaic/literary variant of взрасти/возрасти; 'взросшая' is a participle 'brought up'.

ai:взрезать.note: Here in the sense of tearing open/cutting into the earth's breast; 'взрезаю' is 1st person singular.

ai:взыск.note: Dated noun from взыскать; 'большого взыску не будет' = there won't be a heavy penalty.

ai:взямшить.note: Wrong headword; 'взямши' is Smerdyakov's uneducated gerund of взять ('having taken/supposing'), used as a filler. Nonstandard.

ai:видзел.note: Polish 'widział' (in Russian transliteration), from widzieć 'to see'; spoken by the Polish characters.

ai:видзен.note: Polish-flavored fragment (Polish 'widzę'/'widzieć'); in a broken Polish phrase meaning roughly 'I see (you're) unfriendly and I am gloomy'.

ai:видзение.note: Polish 'widzenie'; appears only in 'до видзенья' = Polish 'do widzenia', goodbye.

ai:видзений.note: Wrong headword; 'до видзенья' is Polish 'do widzenia' (goodbye).

ai:видзеть.note: Polish 'widzieć' (to see) in Russian transliteration; the form 'видзел' is Polish 'widział' (saw).

ai:виляние.note: Verbal noun of вилять; here figuratively, dodging/equivocating before the court.

ai:височек.note: Diminutive of висок (temple); 'височки' = little locks of hair combed forward at the temples.

ai:вкатить.note: Here: to roll/drive a bullet into the gun barrel.

ai:властие.note: Church Slavonic/archaic form of власть; here instrumental 'властию'

ai:вмешивать.note: imperfective of вмешать; here 'bring in (a judgment by merit)'

ai:внаймы.note: variant of внаём; отдаваться внаймы = be offered for rent

ai:внеправда.note: Dostoevsky's nonstandard formation; 'внеправду' = insincerely, not in truth

ai:внушаться.note: here 'внушайтесь' = let yourselves be swayed; 'внушаясь' = being influenced by

ai:водворяться.note: here of the institution of eldership taking hold in monasteries

ai:водевильчик.note: diminutive of водевиль; figuratively light-hearted antics

ai:водонос.note: Church Slavonic (John 2:7, wedding at Cana); 'водоносы' = water jars

ai:возгордиться.note: Church Slavonic flavor; 'возгордясь' is the gerund

ai:возгривый.note: dialectal/archaic; from гривa; here spoken by a peasant describing a man

ai:возжигать.note: Church Slavonic; used of lighting lamps (лампады)

ai:возмериться.note: from the biblical 'какою мерою мерите, возмерится вам'

ai:возненавидиш.note: Church Slavonic 2nd sg. form 'возненавидиши'; here in 'ниже возненавидиши' = nor hate; modern возненавидишь

ai:вознепщеваха.note: Church Slavonic aorist/imperfect (here spelled вознепщеваху); mocking quotation of church language; from вознепщевати 'to suppose'

ai:возношение.note: Church Slavonic flavor; here 'without exalting oneself over them'

ai:возроптать.note: biblical/literary; forms возропщет, возропщешь are future

ai:вольнопрактикующий.note: dated; of a doctor or dentist practicing privately; here used as a noun

g: to take it into one's head
ai:вообразиться.note: impersonal with dative: мне вообразилось = it seemed to me

ai:вор-то-с.note: вор + emphatic -то + servile particle -с (from сударь); here genitive 'вора-то-с'

ai:вороненький.note: diminutive of вороной; 'вороненькую лошадку' = little black horse

ai:воспарять.note: imperfective of воспарить; literary, from a quoted line

ai:воспламеняться.note: Here figurative: flare up with anger.

ai:восприемница.note: Church term, archaic; feminine of восприемник.

ai:воссиять.note: Elevated/Church Slavonic style; second sense: truth shines forth (comes to light).

ai:восст.note: Wrong headword; the form восста is Church Slavonic aorist of воста́ти (воскреснуть), 'arose', from the Gospel phrase 'and the girl arose'.

ai:восстани.note: Church Slavonic imperative of восстати; Gospel-style command.

ai:восстый.note: Wrong headword; восста is Church Slavonic aorist of воста́ти, 'arose' (from 'and the girl arose').

ai:востордить.note: Wrong headword; восторжен is short form of восторженный.

ai:восторжный.note: Short form восторжен; standard form is восторженный.

ai:востро.note: Colloquial; in idiom держать ухо востро: keep one's wits about one, be on guard.

ai:вострый.note: Archaic/dialectal form of острый; text has adverb востро in the idiom держать ухо востро.

ai:восхостить.note: Church Slavonic; correct lemma is восхотеть; восхощу is 1st person singular future ('I shall wish').

ai:восчувствовать.note: Archaic/bookish, with a slightly ironic tone here; 'not feel contempt for me'.

ai:восьмиконечный.note: Orthodox term: eight-pointed cross, embroidered on the monastic schema/cowl.

ai:вправить.note: Here: to put the icon on him, tucking it in under the collar.

ai:вправлять.note: Imperfective of вправить; here: tuck her braid back / fasten the icon.

ai:впросак.note: Idiom попасть впросак: to get into an embarrassing mess, to be caught out.

ai:впрягать.note: Впрягай is imperative; впрягали is past plural.

ai:врачество.note: Church Slavonic/archaic; in the elder's quoted text.

ai:врыть.note: Врытый is past passive participle: dug into the ground.

ai:вседержитель.note: Church Slavonic epithet of God, here used loosely; 'Бог вседержитель' = God Almighty.

ai:всее.note: Nonstandard spelling of всю (accusative of вся); here used with 'себя', a colloquial/dialectal emphatic form.

ai:вскачь.note: Often with гнать/пустить: drive at a gallop.

ai:всклочить.note: Colloquial; всклочены is short passive participle: (hair) tousled.

ai:вскоца.note: Wrong headword; вскоцу is a dialectal/childish form of вскочу ('I will jump up'), with the ц-for-ч pronunciation (цоканье), in the peasant girl's saying 'захоцу — вскоцу'.

ai:вскрикивание.note: Noun from вскрикивать; plural instrumental here.

ai:вспалый.note: Wrong headword; вспало is neuter past of вспасть (на ум): 'it came into his head'.

ai:вспать.note: Archaic/colloquial; used only in вспасть на ум ('to come to one's mind').

ai:вспомянуть.note: Archaic/church-style form of вспомнить; used for praying for someone by name.

ai:вспорхнуться.note: Nonstandard reflexive form of вспорхнуть (to take flight); here 'she fluttered up all excited'.

ai:вспрыгнуть.note: Things on the table 'jumped up' from the blow.

ai:вспрыснуть.note: Imperative Вспрысни; here sprinkle him with water sprayed from the mouth (folk remedy for fainting).

ai:встыд.note: Polish-style form (Polish wstyd); appears in Polish-influenced speech of the Polish officer; the analyzer's headword is questionable.

ai:встыда.note: Wrong headword; the text has 'без встыду', pseudo-Polish for 'shamelessly, without shame' (Polish wstyd).

ai:втюриться.note: Colloquial; usually 'to fall head over heels in love', here 'to get involved in a foolish affair'.

ai:вывертывание.note: Verbal noun from выворачивать/вывёртывать; here describes Maximov's dance of splaying his feet outward.

ai:выдавиться.note: Blood 'squeezed out' from under the nail; a sad smile 'appeared' on his lips (figurative).

ai:выделанно.note: Adverb of выделанный in the sense of 'contrived, put-on'.

ai:выделанный.note: The form in text is the adverb выделанно (affectedly, in a contrived way).

ai:выздоровить.note: Nonstandard/colloquial form of выздороветь; here 'I will get well'.

ai:выказываться.note: Reflexive/passive of выказывать; 'began to show and reveal itself'.

g: to cry out (as a possessed woman)
ai:выкликать.note: Folk term: 'кликуша' is a hysterical woman who shrieks as if possessed; 'кликушей выкликать' = to start shrieking like one.

ai:выколачивать.note: Two uses: 'выколачивать деньгу' = squeeze out money; 'руду выколачивать' = hammer out ore.

ai:выкушать.note: Polite/humorous variant of выпить/съесть (from кушать); here he drank just one small glass of punch.

ai:вымаливание.note: Verbal noun from вымаливать (to obtain by begging).

ai:вымбыть.note: Wrong headword; the text has the infinitive выместь (to sweep out), an old form of вымести.

ai:выместь.note: Archaic/colloquial infinitive of вымести; 'have the square swept'.

ai:вымученно.note: Adverb of вымученный; here used predicatively: it would come out forced.

ai:вымученный.note: Text form вымученно is the adverb/short form (forced, strained).

ai:вымучить.note: Text form вымученного is the participle: 'forced, strained (rapture)'.

ai:выпучиться.note: Colloquial; 'выпучившийся взгляд' = a fixed, bulging-eyed stare.

ai:выпытать.note: Perfective; 'I couldn't get anything out of her'.

ai:вырезание.note: Verbal noun from вырезать; here cutting babies out of the mother's womb.

ai:выс-сечь.note: Spelling of высечь with drawn-out 'с' to show the doctor's angry hissing; 'must be flogged!'

ai:выскрести.note: Colloquial; 'will scrape out the last scrapings'.

ai:выслужиться.note: Here 'выслужился' means he rose in rank again; 'выслужившийся' describes a man risen from the ranks.

ai:выслушание.note: Bureaucratic-style verbal noun from выслушать; 'перейдем к выслушанию' = let us proceed to hearing.

ai:высоконравственный.note: Formal, somewhat ironic compound used by the lawyer.

ai:высокооткроветь.note: Wrong headword; the text word is the adjective высокооткровенный (extremely frank).

ai:высокопреподобие.note: Honorific for an abbot: 'ваше высокопреподобие'; 'его высокопреподобие' refers to him in the third person.

ai:высокоталантливый.note: Used with ironic/formal flourish in the trial speeches.

ai:высунить.note: Form высуня is a gerund of высунуть (colloquial spelling); 'высуня язык' = with tongue hanging out.

ai:выцарапать.note: 'глаза выцарапать' = to scratch someone's eyes out.

g: to let out drop by drop
ai:выцеживать.note: Here figurative: uttering words one at a time, reluctantly.

ai:вычесывать.note: Form вычесывал is imperfective past; here 'combed lice out of'.

ai:вьельфилька.note: Nonstandard rendering of French 'vieille fille'; jocular/colloquial.

ai:вящший.note: Archaic Church Slavonic; form вящше is comparative used adverbially: 'вящше же ничто же' = nothing more.

ai:гадательный.note: Here: uncertain, unfathomable (things beyond human strength).

ai:гадливый.note: Adverb гадливо = with disgust; гадливое презрение = disdainful loathing.

ai:галдарея.note: Dialect/colloquial form of галерея; here as the inn's gallery.

ai:галдареять.note: Wrong headword: галдарею is the accusative of noun галдарея (gallery, dialectal form of галерея).

ai:гамлетовский.note: From Shakespeare's Hamlet; 'гамлетовские вопросы' = questions about what comes after death.

ai:гантированный.note: From obsolete гантировать (from French gant, glove).

ai:гантировать.note: Obsolete; from French gant. Form гантированную is a past passive participle: gloved.

ai:гарнитуровый.note: Old word for a cheap, coarse dress fabric (garniture); here a jeer at Alyosha's trousers.

ai:гвоздочка.note: Diminutive of гвоздь; the analyzer's headword is off, the form гвоздочке is prepositional singular of гвоздочек.

ai:гвоздочко.note: Wrong headword; correct lemma is гвоздочек (diminutive of гвоздь).

ai:геморроидальный.note: Used of a sickly, yellowish complexion.

ai:генеральша-старуха.note: Compound of генеральша (general's wife) and старуха (old woman); genitive form генеральши-старухи.

ai:генеральши-старуха.note: Wrong headword; correct lemma is генеральша-старуха (genitive генеральши-старухи).

ai:геометр.note: Here plural геометры; refers to mathematicians/geometers (cf. non-Euclidean geometry).

ai:гернгутер.note: Member of the Moravian Church (Herrnhut, German); the text itself glosses it as 'моравский брат'.

ai:гернгутереть.note: Wrong headword; the form гернгутер is the noun (Herrnhuter, Moravian Brother).

ai:гешефт.note: From German Geschäft; colloquial/slangy, often with a disparaging tone.

ai:гл.note: Abbreviation of глава (chapter), as in a Bible reference.

ai:глаголати.note: Church Slavonic infinitive of глаголать; archaic, in a quoted liturgical/biblical text.

ai:глаголать.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic; глаголет = speaks, says; глагола = said.

ai:глупенький.note: Diminutive of глупый; often affectionate or condescending.

ai:гноиться.note: Form гноящийся is a present active participle: festering, oozing pus.

ai:гнусненький.note: Diminutive of гнусный, used with contemptuous irony.

ai:голенький.note: Diminutive of голый; here bare little hands of a child.

ai:головорезный.note: Colloquial; derived from головорез (cutthroat, daredevil). Here: reckless, life-risking pranks.

ai:голосочек.note: Diminutive of голос (voice); affectionate, in the instrumental case (голосочком).

ai:голоштанник-с.note: Colloquial, contemptuous (lit. one without trousers). The -с is the servile particle from сударь, used by Smerdyakov.

ai:голубина.note: Church Slavonic form: 'в виде голубине' = in the form of a dove. Correct lemma is голубиный; the phrase is a stylised liturgical/biblical echo.

ai:голубиный.note: Голубиная душа = a gentle, innocent soul (affectionate address).

ai:голыш.note: Colloquial; literally a naked one, also a bare pebble. Here: a pauper with nothing.

ai:гомеопатический-то.note: Form Гомеопатические-то with emphatic particle -то. Here: tiny, homeopathic doses.

ai:горбатенький-то.note: Diminutive of горбатый (hunchbacked) with emphatic particle -то; affectionate.

ai:гордое-прегордый.note: Wrong headword; the text has гордое-прегордое, neuter of гордый-прегордый, an intensifying folk-style repetition with пре-.

ai:гордый-прегордый.note: Intensifying doubling with the prefix пре-; here neuter form гордое-прегордое, modifying сердечко.

ai:горестие.note: Archaic, Church Slavonic form of горесть; горестию is the instrumental (with grief).

ai:горлан.note: Colloquial; someone who shouts loudly; plural горланы.

ai:горошинка.note: Diminutive of горошина (a pea). 'Сделать из горошинки гору' is like making a mountain out of a molehill.

ai:горьчайший.note: Superlative of горький; the neuter form горьчайшее appears in the text.

ai:горячий-горячий.note: Wrong headword; the text has the adverb горячо-горячо, a doubled adverb meaning very warmly/passionately.

ai:горячо-горячий.note: Wrong headword; the text has the adverb горячо-горячо, a repetition for emphasis.

ai:горячо-горячо.note: Doubling of горячо for emphasis, typical of emotional speech.

ai:господчик.note: Diminutive of господин, here slightly ironic or dismissive.

ai:готув.note: Polish gotów (ready) in Polish speech: 'Естем готув' = 'jestem gotów' = I am ready. Foreign word.

ai:готуть.note: Wrong headword; the text is Polish gotów (ready), from 'Естем готув' = 'jestem gotów' = I am ready.

ai:гощение.note: Archaic/dated; the act of being a guest (from гостить); genitive гощения.

ai:гравюрный.note: Related to гравюра (engraving); 'гравюрные изображения' are engraved pictures.

ai:гражданственник.note: Rare; someone who champions civic/social ideals (from гражданственность).

ai:грешничка.note: Affectionate diminutive of грешница, plural форма грешнички; here in a folk-religious tone.

ai:грозд.note: Archaic/poetic form of гроздь; plural грозды. From Schiller's Ode to Joy in Russian translation.

ai:грозда.note: Wrong headword; text has plural грозды of archaic грозд/гроздь (a cluster of grapes).

ai:гроздие.note: Archaic/poetic collective; genitive Гроздий in the poetic verse quoted.

ai:грошик.note: Diminutive of грош (a small old copper coin of little value); plural грошики.

ai:грязненький.note: Diminutive of грязный; here used both literally (a grubby scrap) and figuratively (sordid doubts).

ai:грязноватый.note: Form грязновато used predicatively; -оват- gives the sense of 'rather'.

ai:губенка-то.note: Colloquial, with emphatic particle -то; губенки is the plural of the diminutive губёнка (from губа, lip), used with pity.

ai:губительница.note: Feminine of губитель; instrumental case губительницей.

ai:гуртовщик.note: One who drives a herd (гурт) of livestock to market.

ai:гусынька.note: Affectionate diminutive of гусыня (goose); here from a children's rhyme.

ai:дав.note: Wrong headword; the text has the colloquial adverb даве (earlier, a while ago), from давеча.

ai:давленый.note: Participial adjective from давить; 'как паук давленый' = like a squashed spider.

ai:дантовский.note: Relating to Dante; here Dante-like boldness of imagining torments.

ai:даровитость.note: Abstract noun from даровитый; spoken ironically by Rakitin.

ai:даровой.note: Neuter form даровое; here 'a free show' (даровое представление).

ai:два-три.note: Fixed hyphenated approximate quantity; feminine form две-три with feminine nouns.

ai:двесец.note: Wrong headword: the form двесьце is Polish-flavored speech (Polish dwieście), spoken by the Polish characters.

ai:двоиться.note: Here of the Milky Way looking indistinct/doubled.

ai:двухаршинный.note: An arshin is about 71 cm; here of a dress train.

ai:девчоночка.note: Diminutive of девчонка; colloquial, here a girl of loose morals.

ai:делишек.note: Wrong headword: the form делишку is accusative singular of делишко, a diminutive of дело (business, matter), often slightly shady.

ai:делишки.note: Plural of делишко, a diminutive of дело; slightly pejorative, colloquial.

ai:деньги‑то‑с.note: деньги + emphatic particle то + servile particle -с (short for сударь, sir).

ai:дерзновенный.note: Elevated/Church Slavonic style; the forms in text are short forms and adverb/comparative.

ai:деспотическа.note: Wrong headword; the correct one is деспотически.

ai:десятирублевый.note: Here used as a noun: a ten-ruble note.

ai:десятитысячный.note: Here 'на десятитысячную' means 'to the extent of one ten-thousandth'.

ai:детей-младенец.note: Wrong headword: the text has детей-младенцев, i.e. two infant children (genitive plural).

ai:детушки.note: Plural of детушка; folk/endearing diminutive of дети, used in peasant speech.

ai:диаволов.note: Archaic possessive adjective from диавол; correct form here is диаволово (neuter).

ai:диаволово.note: Neuter possessive of archaic диавол (devil): 'the devil's third temptation'.

ai:диаволовый.note: Wrong headword; the form is possessive диаволов, -а, -о from archaic диавол.

ai:дить.note: Wrong headword: жено is the vocative of жена (woman/wife), Church Slavonic style address, as in Jesus's words 'жено'.

ai:дитять.note: Wrong headword; the form дитятю is accusative of дитятя, a folk/dialect variant of дитя.

ai:дитятя.note: Colloquial/folk form of дитя; here accusative дитятю, spoken by a peasant woman.

ai:длинно-длинный.note: Wrong headword; the form is the adverb reduplication длинно-длинно, 'at very great length'.

ai:длинноватый.note: Here short plural: длинноваты, said of trousers.

ai:длинную-длинный.note: Wrong headword; the text has the reduplicated accusative длинную-длинную улицу, 'a very, very long street'.

ai:длинный-длинный.note: Reduplication for emphasis; adverbial длинно-длинно and accusative длинную-длинную occur in text.

ai:довременный.note: Rare/bookish; the adverb довременно means 'prior to time, eternally'.

ai:догадамнуться.note: Wrong headword; the form догадамшись is Smerdyakov's comic, nonstandard participle of догадаться (to guess, realize), with an illiterate-servant ending.

ai:догадамшиться.note: Wrong headword; догадамшись is a deliberately illiterate/comic form of the gerund of догадаться.

ai:додача.note: Rare/colloquial; from доддавать/додать (to add what is lacking).

ai:дожидать.note: Dialectal/colloquial; standard form is дожидаться (+ genitive). Here 'дожидал их' means 'was waiting for them'.

ai:дознать.note: Rare; дознано is the neuter short passive participle, 'it has been established'. Related to дознание (inquiry).

ai:доказаться.note: Reflexive/passive of доказать; used here half-jokingly by the investigator after 'окажется'.

ai:докладываться.note: Here: to inform Smerdyakov beforehand, to consult him. Imperfective reflexive of доложиться.

ai:докторша.note: Colloquial feminine of доктор, meaning the wife of a doctor (not a female doctor).

ai:долголетний.note: Here in the feminine genitive: 'after a long separation of many years'.

ai:долечить.note: Perfective; долечит is 3rd person future, 'will finish treating'.

ai:доложиться.note: Reflexive of доложить; 'доложитесь' = have yourself announced/report your arrival.

ai:долюбить.note: Perfective formed with до- ('to the end'); poetic use, 'let me finish loving'.

ai:донага.note: Used with раздеть: to strip completely naked.

ai:донушка.note: Diminutive of дно (bottom); the text's донушке is prepositional case, 'on the very bottom'.

ai:донушко.note: Diminutive of дно; the correct nominative is донышко/донушко, here in the prepositional case.

g: of the time before Peter the Great
ai:допетровский.note: Refers to Old Russia before Peter I's reforms; 'допетровская старина' = pre-Petrine antiquity.

ai:доплатить.note: Here: to pay the additional sum still owed.

ai:допрежить.note: Wrong headword; the text word is the adverb/preposition допрежь (earlier, before), colloquial/archaic, as in 'допрежь того' = 'before that'.

ai:допрезать.note: Wrong headword; the text word is допрежь, colloquial/archaic adverb 'before, previously'.

ai:допросчик.note: Rare; the one conducting a допрос (interrogation).

ai:дорезать.note: Perfective; here 'не дорезала' = did not finish the job of cutting (killing).

ai:дорогонек.note: Colloquial diminutive-like form of дорогой; дорогонько is the adverb 'rather dearly'.

ai:доселевый.note: Wrong headword; the text word is доселева, an archaic/colloquial adverb meaning 'until now'.

g: to ride at a gallop to
ai:доскакать.note: Perfective; here 'Доскакали до...' = they galloped all the way to.

ai:доставление.note: Verbal noun of доставить; 'для доставления себе удовольствия' = to give oneself pleasure.

ai:доставша.note: Church Slavonic; 'не доставшу вину' = 'when the wine ran out' (John 2:3, dative absolute).

ai:достоять.note: Church Slavonic form: 'не достоит' = 'it is not fitting/proper'.

g: to succeed in getting a response by knocking
ai:достучаться.note: Perfective; достучаться = knock long enough to be let in.

ai:досуха-с.note: досуха with servile particle -с (Smerdyakov's obsequious speech); 'тереть досуха' = rub until dry.

ai:доткнентный.note: Polish, not Russian: 'Jestem do żywego dotknięty' = 'I am cut to the quick'; the text has a Polish phrase in Russian spelling.

ai:дочка-мужичка.note: Compound; here мужичка is a feminine form of мужик (peasant) used as a modifier: a daughter who is a peasant woman.

ai:дочка-мужичок.note: Wrong headword; the text has дочка-мужичка, with мужичка as feminine of мужик (peasant).

ai:древлема.note: Wrong headword; the text form древлему is dative of древлий (Church Slavonic/archaic 'ancient'): 'по древлему обряду' = by the ancient rite.

ai:дробинка.note: Single grain of shot (birdshot), diminutive of дробь; here loaded into a toy cannon.

ai:друга.note: Wrong headword; text form is други, archaic/Church Slavonic plural of друг (friend), used as a form of address: 'Други мои' = my friends.

ai:дурачество.note: From дурачиться (to play the fool); 'простить дурачеству' = forgive the foolery.

ai:дурачье.note: Colloquial collective noun from дурак; dismissive/abusive.

ai:дурища.note: Augmentative/pejorative of дура (fool, feminine); colloquial, here half-affectionate.

ai:дуэльный.note: Here in the genitive plural: дуэльных пистолетов = duelling pistols.

ai:дышать-дышать.note: Wrong headword: the text has the doubled form дышит-дышит, from дышать 'to breathe'; the repetition is for emphasis (breathes and breathes).

ai:дышит-дышать.note: Wrong headword: the text has the doubled form дышит-дышит, from дышать; repetition conveys labored, continuous breathing.

ai:дюжинк.note: Wrong headword: the form дюжинки is from the diminutive дюжинка, from дюжина 'dozen'.

ai:дюжинка.note: Colloquial diminutive of дюжина; here in the genitive: три дюжинки = three dozen.

ai:еврей-часовщик.note: Compound of еврей 'Jew' and часовщик 'watchmaker'; here in the dative: еврею-часовщику.

ai:еврею-часовщик.note: Wrong headword: this is the dative of the compound еврей-часовщик.

ai:европеизм.note: Here in the dative; the word appears in quotation marks in the text, referring to the Europeanized outlook of Ivan.

ai:един.note: Church Slavonic/archaic form of один; едину is the accusative feminine, 'a single (minute)'.

ai:едина.note: Church Slavonic/archaic feminine of един ('one'); едину is the accusative feminine, used emphatically: минуточку едину = one single minute.

ai:единиться.note: Rare/bookish, related to единый; here 'the world grows ever more united'.

g: penitential discipline imposed by the Church
ai:епитимия.note: Modern spelling епитимья; here in the plural: как епитимии = as acts of penance.

ai:естем.note: Polish 'jestem' (I am), written in Russian letters as spoken by the Polish characters; e.g. естем готув = jestem gotów, 'I am ready'.

ai:естема.note: Wrong headword: the form is Polish 'jestem' (I am), transliterated into Cyrillic as spoken by the Polish characters.

ai:естественник.note: Dated term for someone who studied natural science; here instrumental: кончил курс естественником.

ai:жалеючи.note: Dialectal/colloquial gerund of жалеть, used by the servant Smerdyakov; standard form is жалея.

ai:жалеючий.note: Wrong headword: the text form жалеючи is a colloquial gerund of жалеть (standard жалея), not an adjective.

ai:жалеючить.note: Wrong headword: the text form жалеючи is a colloquial gerund of жалеть (standard жалея).

ai:жартовать.note: Polish 'żartować' (to joke), spoken by a Polish character; the text glosses it as 'шутишь'.

ai:жартуесть.note: Wrong headword: the form is Polish 'żartujesz' (you're joking), from żartować, written in Cyrillic.

ai:желаться.note: Impersonal use: желается = one wants/it is wished; here 'what he himself wants'.

ai:желторотость.note: From желторотый ('yellow-beaked' = callow, naive); refers to youthful inexperience.

ai:женимнуться.note: Wrong headword: женимшись is a nonstandard/dialectal gerund of жениться (standard женившись), in Smerdyakov's speech.

ai:женимшиться.note: Wrong headword: женимшись is a nonstandard/dialectal gerund of жениться (standard женившись), in Smerdyakov's speech.

ai:женный.note: Wrong headword: жено is the Church Slavonic vocative of жена ('woman, wife'), as in 'Woman, what have I to do with thee' (John 2:4).

ai:женщина-соперница.note: Compound; here in the genitive plural: женщины-соперницы.

ai:женщины-соперница.note: Wrong headword: the text form is the plural of the compound женщина-соперница.

ai:женый.note: Wrong headword: жено is the Church Slavonic vocative of жена ('woman, wife').

ai:жеребеночек.note: Diminutive of жеребёнок (foal); spelled жеребеночек without ё.

ai:жестокосердный.note: Here as the adverb жестокосердно: 'cruelly, mercilessly'; a bookish/emphatic word.

ai:живий.note: Polish-style/Ukrainian-like form; 'до живего' is Polish 'do żywego' meaning 'to the quick'. Spoken by a Polish character (естем до живего доткнентным = I am stung to the quick).

ai:живодерность.note: Rare coinage from живодёр (flayer, tormentor); refers to merciless, exploitative nature.

ai:жидененок.note: Derogatory/contemptuous diminutive from жид; here plural instrumental жиденятами, in the narrator's ironic listing of Jewish acquaintances.

ai:жидишка.note: Derogatory diminutive of жид, offensive today; here instrumental plural жидишками.

ai:жидишко.note: Derogatory diminutive of жид (Jew), offensive today; here genitive singular жидишки, in Rakitin's cynical speech.

ai:жидовка.note: Derogatory term (жид is offensive in modern Russian); here instrumental, about Grushenka's business acumen: 'a regular Jewess'.

ai:жизние.note: Wrong headword: жизнию is an archaic/bookish instrumental of жизнь ('life'), i.e. 'by life'.

ai:жилочка.note: Diminutive of жила (vein, sinew); here plural instrumental жилочками, describing veined streaks in a stone.

ai:жирненький.note: diminutive of жирный; here in the prepositional form 'на жирненьком личике' (a plump little face)

ai:забеглый.note: colloquial; here of a dog that ran in from a village and settled

ai:завиствовать.note: rare/dialectal; here a participle form, 'envious ones'; likely from завидовать

ai:завиствующий.note: rare/dialectal participle of завиствовать; from завидовать; иных завиствующих = 'some of the envious'

ai:завить.note: here завитой is a participle: with curled hair

ai:завиться.note: in this context colloquial: 'пошёл, завился' means went off carousing

ai:загноиться.note: used figuratively here: the people have 'festered' from drunkenness

ai:загорланить.note: colloquial, perfective of горланить; here in the future tense: will start bawling a song

ai:задирчивый.note: colloquial; related to задирать; the analyzer form given is the adverb задирчиво

ai:задохся.note: masculine past tense of задохнуться; the headword form is nonstandard, the correct infinitive is задохнуться

ai:задразнить.note: perfective of дразнить, with a sense of teasing someone to the limit

ai:заживить.note: transitive; here figuratively 'заживить царапину' = to heal a scratch

ai:заздравный.note: заздравный бокал = a glass raised in a toast to someone's health; from здравие

ai:зазнамо.note: dated/colloquial; here in the phrase 'заранее и зазнамо' = beforehand and knowingly

ai:зазорно.note: here used predicatively (short form): 'it was improper'; related to зазор (shame)

ai:зазорный.note: dated; short forms зазорно, зазорен = shameful or improper

ai:заискать.note: rare/dated; here 'искусство заискать' = the art of ingratiating oneself

g: to vow never to do again

ai:заключиться.note: reflexive of заключить; in this text: 'to be completed' or 'to consist of'

g: to swear by all that is holy
ai:заклясться-забожиться.note: colloquial doubled verb formed from заклясться + забожиться (to swear by God); the text has the form заклялась-забожилась

ai:заколоться.note: reflexive of заколоть; закололся = stabbed himself

ai:закопошиться.note: figurative here: jealousy began stirring again in his heart

ai:закорузлой.note: form of закорузлый (callused, stiffened from wear/dirt); text has закорузлые sapozhki

ai:закорузлый.note: of worn boots or hands; the text has the plural form закорузлые

ai:закоулочек.note: diminutive of закоулок (back alley, blind alley)

ai:закочевать.note: the participle закочевавший = who had wandered in (about the gypsy camp)

g: to cross with the sign of the cross
to make the sign of the cross over
ai:закрестить.note: colloquial; закрестил = crossed him (to ward off a devil)

ai:закурчавленный.note: participle of закурчавить/закурчавлить (to curl); of hair, like a ram's

ai:закурчавлить.note: rare; the standard form is закурчавить; text has passive participle закурчавленные

ai:закутить.note: Perfective; colloquial, often 'to start a binge'.

ai:залавок.note: Dialectal/dated; a wooden bench or counter in a peasant hut; the text form залавке is prepositional.

ai:заласкать.note: Colloquial; here ironic: 'how have you so charmed him?'

ai:заливчатый.note: Describes ringing, rolling sounds such as laughter or sobbing.

ai:залихватский.note: Colloquial; describes daring, lively songs or dances.

ai:замечаньице.note: Diminutive of замечание, colloquial spelling замечаньице.

ai:замолить.note: Here: 'mother prayed for me' (замолила about/за него).

ai:замутиться.note: Here figurative: the Orthodox faith has become corrupted/blurred.

ai:заплатать.note: Form заплатанном is participle 'patched'; standard is заплатанный.

ai:заплатка.note: Nom. sg. заплатка, instr. pl. заплатками.

ai:заплеснесть.note: Nonstandard variant; correct verb is заплесневеть.

ai:запоить.note: Here: he plied peasants with champagne.

ai:запредчувствовать.note: Rare; text form запредчувствовав is a gerund.

ai:запрошлый.note: Colloquial; запрошлый год = year before last; here 'the generation before the last'.

ai:запрячь-оседлать.note: Compound of запрячь and оседлать; text form запрягли-оседлали, used figuratively 'we've worked her like a horse'.

ai:запылать.note: Perfective inchoative; figurative: burned with vengeance, cheeks flushed.

ai:зарана.note: Dialectal/colloquial; text form заране; standard заранее.

ai:заранний.note: Analyzer headword wrong; зараньше is a colloquial variant of the adverb заранее/заране.

ai:зарез.note: Used in idiom до зарезу 'desperately, absolutely (need)'; text form зарезу.

ai:иезуитский.note: From иезуит (Jesuit); often figurative: sophistical, crafty.

ai:иеродиакон.note: Eastern Orthodox monk who is also a deacon; here dative plural иеродиаконам.

ai:извозчичий.note: From извозчик (cab driver); here 'извозчичья коляска' = a hired carriage.

ai:издохнуть.note: Coarse when applied to people; here 'I'll die like a dog there'.

ai:излечиться.note: Perfective; 'излечиться от любви к человечеству' = to be cured of love for humanity.

ai:износиться.note: Here figurative: 'words have all worn out (become trite)'.

ai:изразцовый.note: From изразец (glazed decorative tile); 'изразцовая печь' = tiled stove.

ai:изъяснение.note: Bookish; 'изъяснение в любви' = a declaration of love.

ai:индюшечка.note: Diminutive of индюшка (turkey hen); playful in Fyodor Pavlovich's speech.

ai:иноческий.note: From инок (monk); 'иноческий подвиг' = monastic feat/ascetic labor.

ai:иноязычник.note: Archaic/church usage: one of another tongue or faith, a non-Christian; here in Smerdyakov's argument about cursing God.

ai:искательный.note: The text form искательно is the adverb.

ai:испити.note: Church Slavonic infinitive of испить; from the monastic fasting rule text.

ai:исповедальный.note: Here used as a noun-like adjective: confessional booths.

ai:исповедование.note: Verbal noun of исповедовать; here the ongoing confessing of one's soul to the elder.

ai:исполнимый.note: Text form исполнимо is the short neuter/predicative form: 'it is feasible'.

ai:исправничий.note: Possessive adjective from исправник; the 'police chief's daughters'.

ai:испытовать.note: Wrong headword; испытуешь is the archaic/literary verb испытовать/испытывать form ('you test me').

ai:иссякновение.note: Bookish noun from иссякнуть; here: the loss of belief in immortality.

ai:истязательный.note: The text form истязательно is the adverb.

ai:каждогодный.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong; the text form is the adverb каждогодно (every year).

ai:казуист.note: Used as an insult: someone who twists arguments over fine points.

ai:кантик.note: Diminutive of кант (edging); here the trimmed edge of a cap.

ai:каплун.note: Figurative insult here: castrated cock, i.e. spineless people.

ai:кардинальский.note: From кардинал (Catholic cardinal); refers to the Grand Inquisitor.

ai:картинность.note: Here with a slightly negative sense of showy effect.

ai:ква-ква.note: Onomatopoeia for a duck; from a nursery-style song.

ai:квадриллионный.note: Here in the phrase 'to the quadrillionth power'; humorous hyperbole.

ai:кипень.note: Found in the idiom 'белый как кипень' (snow-white).

ai:кипучий.note: Here describes youthful energy and hot blood.

ai:клака.note: In the text used loosely for a burst of applause from the audience.

ai:клерикал.note: Ironic quotation marks in the text; means the monastery party.

ai:кликуша.note: Peasant women subject to shrieking fits believed to be demonic possession.

ai:коломянка.note: Cheap durable fabric used for summer clothes.

ai:комедиант.note: Here figurative: a man who plays a part, a fraud.

ai:комедь.note: Colloquial/archaic form of комедия; 'комедь играть' = to put on an act.

ai:конфеточка.note: Diminutive of конфета; 'конфеточек' is genitive plural.

ai:корпия.note: Old medical term: shredded linen used as wound dressing.

ai:котиковый.note: From котик (fur seal); котиковая фуражка = sealskin cap.

ai:который-нибудь.note: Indefinite: 'за которую-нибудь' = over some woman or other.

ai:крепостник.note: Used as a political insult in the reform era.

ai:крошечка.note: Diminutive of крошка; 'ни крошечки' = not a bit.

ai:крулев.note: Wrong headword: 'крулева' is a Polish-flavored form of королева (queen), spoken by the Poles.

ai:ктур.note: Wrong headword: foreign, Polish 'Która godzina, panie?' = 'What time is it, sir?'; spelled Russian-style.

ai:кубарь.note: Colloquial; кубари спускать = to spin tops.

ai:кулачат.note: Form of кулачить/кулачить: to act as a kulak, profiteer and dominate the market.

ai:кулачонка.note: Wrong headword: 'кулачонками' is instrumental plural of кулачонок, diminutive of кулак (fist).

ai:купчина.note: augmentative of купец; colloquial, slightly disparaging

ai:лайдак.note: Polish łajdak; said by the Poles in the scene

ai:лакомствовать.note: dated; used ironically by Dmitri and Ракитин

ai:лаптишка.note: diminutive/pejorative of лапоть; лаптишках is prepositional plural

ai:легконогий.note: here a jesting euphemism for a promiscuous woman

ai:лжеподобие.note: rare, book-style; here a false image of Christ

ai:ликерец.note: diminutive of ликёр; ликерцем is instrumental, ликерцу partitive genitive

ai:лисить.note: colloquial; from лиса (fox); more common: лебезить/лисить

ai:лихоимствовать.note: archaic/biblical; imperative лихоимствуйте with negation 'Do not extort'

ai:лишимнуться.note: nonstandard spelling of лишиться; the lemma is a mistaken guess

ai:ложесна.note: Church Slavonic plural (ложесна); biblical, from Luke 'the womb'; Smerdyakov quotes it mockingly

ai:людье.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic plural 'людие' (= люди), from a holy man's speech.

ai:лютеранствуть.note: Wrong headword; the participle лютеранствующий comes from the verb лютеранствовать.

ai:ляд.note: Colloquial, euphemism for чёрт; 'на кой ляд' = 'what the devil for'.

ai:ляд-с.note: 'ляд' with the servile particle -с (from сударь), as spoken by Smerdyakov.

ai:мазурик.note: Colloquial; from the old sense of a pickpocket or petty thief.

ai:малоречивый.note: Bookish; text has short form малоречив.

ai:малословный.note: Rare; here describes a short, wordless farewell.

ai:маменька.note: Affectionate, somewhat old-fashioned diminutive of мать.

ai:маменька-то.note: Form of маменька with the emphatic particle -то.

ai:мамзель.note: Colloquial Russification of French mademoiselle, often slightly ironic.

ai:мамуровка.note: Colloquial/dialectal; a kind of homemade sweet liqueur or cordial.

ai:манишка.note: Detachable shirt front worn under a jacket or vest.

ai:мараться.note: Often figurative: to sully oneself by getting involved.

ai:математически.note: Here: with absolute clarity or exactness.

ai:матерью-земля.note: Wrong headword; correct is мать-земля, here in the instrumental (матерью-землёю).

ai:маточка.note: Colloquial/folk endearment; here a term of affection addressed to a woman.

ai:мгновеньице.note: Diminutive of мгновение (moment), used for ironic effect.

ai:меблированный.note: Participial adjective from меблировать; here a room furnished with old furniture.

ai:мелкоподрядный.note: From мелкий подряд (small contract); here 'a small contracting business'.

ai:меняльный.note: Dated adjective from меняла (money changer); меняльная лавка = money-changing shop.

ai:мериться.note: Passive in the biblical proverb (мерится = is measured out); reflexive 'measure oneself (one's height)' in the second sentence.

ai:мефистофелевский.note: From Mephistopheles (Goethe's Faust). Neuter form мефистофелевское.

ai:мець.note: Polish (mieć), spoken by the Polish characters; not Russian.

ai:мигрений.note: Wrong headword; the text form мигреня is a nonstandard genitive of мигрень (migraine).

ai:мигренить.note: Wrong headword; the word in the text is мигреня, a form of мигрень 'migraine'.

ai:мигреня.note: Colloquial/old form of мигрень; here genitive ('an attack of migraine').

ai:милосердый.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic-flavored variant of милосердный; милосерд is the short form.

ai:мимоидущий.note: Church Slavonic-style participle; modern мимо идущий/преходящий.

ai:минуться.note: Archaic/poetic; standard form is пройти/минуть; минется = will pass.

g: rich peasant who preys on the commune
ai:мироед.note: Pejorative for a kulak-type who bleeds the peasant community (мир).

ai:миусовский.note: Possessive adjective from the surname Миусов; here dative masculine миусовскому (nephew).

ai:младенческа.note: Wrong headword; the form in the text is младенчески, adverb from младенческий (infantile, childlike).

ai:многолетный.note: The text form многолетно is used adverbially ('over many years', persistently); the adjective is многолетний.

ai:многоречивый.note: Bookish; многоречив is the short form.

ai:многоречий.note: Wrong headword; the text has многоречию, dative of многоречие (verbosity).

ai:многочтить.note: Wrong headword; the text has многочтимой, from the adjective/participle многочтимый 'highly esteemed', ironically paired with многоуважаемый.

ai:моген.note: Polish-flavored/mock speech of the Poles (Polish mogę / Russian могу); 'Чем моген служиць' = 'how can I serve'.

ai:могий.note: Wrong headword; могим is a peasant/nonstandard form of the verb (мы) можем: 'we can judge'.

ai:можа.note: Polish-style (może) in the mouth of a Pole; not Russian.

ai:мокретить.note: Wrong headword; the text has мокреть, a colloquial noun meaning wet, damp, rainy weather.

ai:мокринский.note: Adjective from the village name Мокрое (Mokroye).

ai:молебщик.note: From молебен; a person who offers prayers on behalf of others.

ai:молельщик.note: Variant of молебщик; someone praying for another.

ai:моление.note: Church Slavonic-flavored; 'нежный до моления' = tender to the point of supplication.

g: to act younger than one's age
ai:молодиться.note: Text has the participle молодящаяся 'trying to look young'.

ai:молодцеватый.note: молодцевато is the adverb ('jauntily, with bravado').

ai:молчальник.note: Used of monks who keep silence as an ascetic practice.

ai:молчальный.note: Rare adjective from молчать; here feminine молчальная (улыбочка).

ai:монпансье.note: Indeclinable; from French monpensier, a kind of boiled sweets sold in tins.

ai:монструозный.note: Here the adverb form монструозно ('it's outrageous'); a bookish borrowing from Latin/French monstrueux.

ai:моравский.note: «Моравские братья» = the Moravian Brethren (Herrnhuter), a pietist Protestant sect.

ai:мордасы.note: Colloquial/humorous plural noun (usually мордасы); 'по мордасам' = 'across the face', i.e. slap or thrash. From морда.

ai:му-му.note: Onomatopoeia for a cow's lowing, from a children's-style song.

ai:мувена.note: Wrong headword. In text 'мувен' is Polish mówię, 'I speak/say', transliterated; 'ниц не мувен' = 'I said nothing'. Speech of Polish characters.

ai:мувено.note: Wrong headword. 'мувен' is Polish mówię ('I say'), in the phrase 'ниц не мувен против' = 'I said nothing against'.

ai:муви.note: Polish mówi ('he/she says'), transliterated in the speech of Polish characters.

ai:мувить.note: Polish mówić, transliterated; 'цо мувишь' = 'what you say', from the Polish proverb 'co mówisz, to się stanie'.

ai:мувиць.note: Polish mówić (to speak), in Polish-flavored speech; 'так мувиць не пржистои' = 'it is not proper to speak so'.

ai:мувный.note: Wrong headword. 'мувен' is Polish mówię ('I say'); a transliterated Polish word in the Poles' speech.

ai:мужичий.note: Derived from мужик (peasant); slightly dismissive or colloquial.

ai:мужичонкий.note: Wrong headword; the correct one is мужичонко (or мужичонка), a contemptuous or pitying diminutive of мужик.

ai:мужичонко.note: Diminutive-pejorative of мужик (peasant), with a pitying or contemptuous tone.

ai:мучающийся.note: Present active participle of мучаться (to suffer); dative case мучающемуся.

ai:мучительски.note: Colloquial/nonstandard adverb from мучитель; 'мучительски мучить' = 'to torment mercilessly'.

ai:мыслибус.note: Humorous fake-Latin form of мысль, from the tag 'de gustibus non est disputandum' (there is no arguing about tastes), twisted to 'de мыслибус'.

ai:мыслибусы.note: Wrong headword; 'мыслибус' is a mock-Latin ending on мысль, parodying 'de gustibus non est disputandum'.

ai:мыслие.note: Archaic/bookish form of мысль; 'этою мыслию' is instrumental singular (modern мыслью).

ai:мястись.note: Wrong headword; the correct one is мятущийся (from метаться/мятись), 'restless, agitated, tormented'. The form 'мятущегося' is the genitive of the participle-adjective.

ai:н-нет-с.note: Hesitant 'нет' with the servile particle -с (from сударь), a stammered polite refusal.

ai:наафонить.note: Slang, from офеня/афоня (peddler cant); 'наафонил я' = 'I've conned my share'; slangy colloquial.

ai:наблюсти.note: Bookish; here 'to see to, keep watch over', i.e. to uphold one's own dignity.

ai:навыдумать.note: Perfective of навыдумывать, colloquial; 'навыдумала себе препятствия' = 'dreamed up obstacles'.

ai:навыдумывать.note: Colloquial; 'навыдумывал ужасов' = 'imagined all kinds of horrors'.

ai:нагло-вызывать.note: Wrong headword; 'нагло-вызывающее' is a compound adjective form of нагло-вызывающий, 'brazenly challenging'.

ai:нагло-вызывающий.note: Compound of нагло (insolently) + вызывающий (challenging); neuter form here.

ai:наглупить.note: Colloquial perfective, from глупить (to act stupidly).

ai:наглядело.note: Wrong headword; 'наглядел' is past masculine of наглядеть, 'to spot, pick out'.

ai:наглядеть.note: Colloquial; 'давно наглядел' = 'had long had my eye on'.

ai:нагорать.note: Said of a candle whose wick chars and grows long ('свечка нагорала').

g: to blurt out a heap of nonsense
ai:нагородить.note: Colloquial; 'нагородить ахинеи' = 'to talk a load of rubbish'.

ai:наготовить.note: Perfective; here the passive participle-like 'наготовлено' = 'has been prepared'.

ai:наградной.note: 'Наградные (деньги)' = reward money, tip or bonus; here genitive plural used as a noun.

ai:наградные.note: Plural noun (from наградные деньги), a bonus or fee given as a reward.

ai:нагреметь.note: Colloquial perfective of греметь (to thunder, clatter); 'нашумит, нагремит' = 'makes a lot of noise'.

g: to add to a price or offer

ai:надворный.note: надворные строения = outbuildings; надворный советник = Court Councillor, a rank in the Table of Ranks

ai:надзвездный.note: here spelled надзвездную; ironic in Ivan's speech

ai:надотить.note: analyzer error; the text form is the dialectal predicate надоть, see надоть

ai:надоть.note: dialectal/colloquial for надо; 'надоть быть' = 'probably, must be' in peasant speech

ai:надрезать.note: надрезано is the short passive participle: slit, notched (ear)

ai:надсмехаться.note: colloquial variant of насмехаться, used with над + instrumental

ai:надтреснутый.note: надтреснутым голосом = in a cracked voice

ai:надуматься.note: perfective; here 'as if he had made up his mind'

ai:назидательный.note: form назидательно is the adverb; the lemma is the adjective

ai:наистрожайше.note: superlative with наи- of строжайше; emphatic, somewhat archaic

ai:наистрожайший.note: text form наистрожайше is the adverb; наи- is an archaic superlative prefix

ai:найлепнуть.note: wrong headword; найлепши is Polish 'najlepszy', 'the best', spoken by the Poles

ai:наказовать.note: archaic/Church Slavonic form of наказывать; наказую = 'I punish', наказуй = 'punish!'

ai:наказуй.note: archaic imperative of наказовать/наказывать; the text also has наказую 'I punish'

ai:наказый.note: wrong headword; наказую is the archaic 1st person of наказовать, 'to punish'

ai:накашиваться.note: here 'на лужайке накашивалось' = several poods of hay were mown each summer

ai:наколотить.note: here colloquial: 'наколотишь рубль на копейку' = you'll make a rouble on a kopeck

ai:наколочка.note: diminutive of наколка, a lady's ornamental headpiece

ai:накутиль.note: analyzer error; correct infinitive is накутить, colloquial 'to make a spree, cause a rumpus'

ai:накутить.note: colloquial; 'что мы там накутили' = what a fuss we made there

ai:налево-то-с.note: налево + emphatic -то + servile particle -с (from сударь), typical of Smerdyakov's speech

ai:наперерыв.note: often наперебой/наперегонки sense; 'все наперерыв' = everyone vying

ai:написаться.note: perfective reflexive; 'не написалось' = would not have got written

ai:наплывной.note: rare; 'наплывным ветром' = by some drifting, passing wind

ai:наполниша.note: Church Slavonic aorist 3rd pl. of наполнити (наполнить); from the Gospel of John (Cana wedding)

ai:напомадить.note: напомаженный = pomaded, slicked with hair oil

ai:напророчить.note: Perfective; here 'словно и напророчил' = 'as if he had prophesied it'.

ai:напутственный.note: Used in 'напутственное слово' = parting words, words of send-off or final instruction.

ai:наразбить.note: Nonstandard/dialectal; here the adverbial participle 'наразбив' means 'piecemeal, in a scattered way', citing facts out of order.

ai:насадиться.note: Passive/reflexive of насадить; here said of the institution of elders (старчество) being established at the monastery.

ai:наседка.note: Here 'к наседке' = to the mother hen, of chicks huddling to it.

ai:насказать-с.note: Form 'насказали-с' with servile particle -с (Smerdyakov's obsequious speech). Perfective of насказать.

ai:насмешник.note: Forms in text: насмешники, насмешникам, насмешников (plural).

g: to laugh at, make fun of
to have one's fill of laughing
ai:насмеяться.note: 'Насмеешься' = you'll have your laugh (at someone's expense); 'насмеяться над' = to mock.

ai:насмотреть.note: Colloquial perfective, 'давно насмотрел' = I've had my eye on her for a long time.

ai:насоздаваль.note: Wrong headword; the correct lemma is насоздавать (perfective, 'to create a lot of').

ai:насоздавать.note: Colloquial perfective; 'насоздавали романов' = have created (lots of) novels.

ai:насоздать.note: Colloquial perfective, 'насоздаст себе новых чудес' = will create for himself new miracles.

ai:наставиться.note: Here 'наставившись на Митю, как петухи' = squaring up to Mitya like roosters.

ai:наустить.note: Colloquial; 'он меня наустил' = he put me up to it.

ai:научение.note: Here 'без научения' = without being taught (genitive form научения).

g: to dye or wax (a moustache) black
ai:нафабрить.note: From фабра (moustache dye/wax); 'нафабренные усики' = waxed, blackened little moustaches.

g: to act up, make a fuss
ai:нафонзонить.note: Colloquial, apparently from the surname Фонвизин/'Фонзон'; here 'что ты там нафонзонил' = what have you been up to/causing there. Meaning is somewhat uncertain.

ai:нахвататься.note: Colloquial; 'где вы этого нахватались' = where did you pick that up.

ai:начальствовать.note: The form 'начальствующее' is really a participle of this verb ('the one in command').

ai:начальствующий.note: Participle used as adjective; 'начальствующее лицо' = person in authority.

ai:начетливость.note: Refers to being well-read in religious texts ('от божественного'); noun from начетливый.

ai:нашалить.note: Perfective of шалить; forms нашалит (3sg), нашалят (3pl).

ai:наэлектризовать.note: Figurative; 'наэлектризованы' = were electrified, keyed up (past passive participle).

ai:небедный.note: Formed with не- + бедный; 'небедная вдова' = a comfortably-off widow.

ai:небесеха.note: Wrong headword. 'на небесех' is Church Slavonic locative plural of небеса, from a Bible quotation (Phil. 3:20: 'our citizenship is in heaven').

ai:небесить.note: Wrong headword. 'на небеси' is the Church Slavonic locative singular of небо/небеса ('in heaven'); archaic/biblical.

ai:неблагородный.note: Not noble in character; forms: неблагородного, неблагородным.

ai:неблизкий.note: Here the adverb 'неблизко' = not soon/far off in time or distance.

ai:небрезгливый.note: Here of a plan that is coarse, showing no delicacy.

ai:невежливость.note: Here in instrumental: 'с невежливостью' = with rudeness.

ai:невероятность.note: Noun from невероятный; 'невероятность выдумки' = the implausibility of the fabrication.

ai:невзирая.note: Gerund of невзирать; 'невзирая на' = regardless of; a somewhat bookish preposition-like use.

ai:невмочь.note: Colloquial predicative; 'ему невмочь' = he can't stand/bear it.

ai:невоздержный.note: Applied to a person who indulges without limits, especially in drink.

ai:невыгода.note: Genitive невыгоды; here 'некоторой для себя невыгоды' = some disadvantage to himself.

ai:невыдержка.note: Noun from невыдержанный; 'молодая невыдержка' = youthful lack of restraint.

ai:невыясниться.note: Analyzer's headword is off; the form невыясниvшийся is a participle of невыясниться, meaning 'not yet clarified/defined'.

ai:недодать.note: Here недоданное/недоданных is a past passive participle: 'not given in full, withheld'.

ai:недружелюбный.note: Short form недружелюбен = 'was unfriendly'; недружелюбно is the adverb.

ai:незавершиться.note: Here a participle: 'unfinished, incomplete (time/age)'; normally written as не завершившийся.

ai:незаживать.note: Participle незаживавшая = 'unhealed, never-healing'; normally спelled не заживавшая.

ai:незапятнать.note: Really the short adjective form незапятнано (from незапятнанный): 'unsullied, spotless'.

ai:незначащий.note: Present participle of значить with не-; also normally written незначащий.

ai:неизбежимый.note: Nonstandard/dialectal-sounding variant of неизбежный (or of неминуемый).

ai:неизбежить.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong; the form неизбежимым is an adjective (see неизбежимый), a variant of неизбежный.

ai:неизменимый.note: Here neuter short form неизменимо: 'it cannot be changed'.

ai:неизменить.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong; неизменимо is the short adjective form of неизменимый.

ai:неискаженный.note: Text spells adverb неискаженно without ё: 'in undistorted form'.

ai:неискупленный.note: Here refers to tears not atoned for/avenged; also diminutive слезки in the text.

ai:неисповедимый.note: Set phrase: неисповедимые судьбы (Providence's ways are inscrutable); church register.

ai:нейти.note: Really не идут: negation не + идти (нейдут is a fused, older spelling).

ai:некаторжный.note: Coined by contrast: 'one who is not a convict'; normally не каторжному.

ai:некиий.note: Church Slavonic form; correct lemma is некий. Genitive plural некиих: 'certain (things)'.

ai:нелегкомысленный.note: Normally written не легкомысленные; used of Grigory's weighty words.

ai:нелюбопытный.note: In this usage means 'not interesting/boring', not 'incurious'.

ai:неминучий.note: Dated/folk-flavored; here of the spasm that inevitably seized him (epileptic fit).

ai:немудрено.note: Predicative use: немудрено, что... = 'it is no wonder that...'.

ai:немудреный.note: Form немудрено is the predicative 'no wonder'; the analyzer's headword немудрёный means 'simple, unsophisticated'.

ai:немудрый.note: In the text: 'простодушное немудрое веселие' = simple, artless joy.

ai:ненасытимо.note: Adverb of ненасытимый; rare/literary, formed with the -им- suffix (cf. ненасытно).

ai:ненасытить.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong; the forms come from the adjective ненасытимый (insatiable), not a verb.

ai:необделанный.note: Literally 'not worked/finished'; here describes raw, unpolished force.

ai:необширный.note: Short form необширна; negation of обширный (spacious).

ai:неопределимый.note: Sometimes spelled неопределимый; the text has the feminine неопределимая.

ai:неотвязный.note: The forms in text are the adverb неотвязно; the adjective describes something that won't leave one alone.

ai:неотлучно.note: Adverb of неотлучный; from отлучиться 'to go away'.

ai:неотлучный.note: The forms in text are the adverb неотлучно.

ai:неотомщенный.note: Participial adjective from отомстить; ё not written in the text (неотомщенный).

ai:неотразимость.note: Noun from неотразимый; here the irrefutable force of the accusation.

ai:неповинный.note: Somewhat archaic/literary; cf. невиновный. Short form неповинен.

ai:неподвластный.note: Here substantivized in the genitive plural: those not under authority.

ai:непочтительно.note: Adverb of непочтительный; also used predicatively ('it was disrespectful').

ai:непреоборимый.note: Literary variant of непреодолимый/непобедимый; from преоборить 'to overcome'.

ai:неприютный.note: Quoted here from Schiller-style poetry; describes shores offering no shelter.

ai:непропорциональный.note: Here: strikingly unequal in height compared to the other man.

ai:непщовать.note: Archaic Church Slavonic word; Непщуйте is the imperative 'think/judge for yourselves'.

ai:неразрешенный.note: Participial adjective from разрешить; ё not written in the text.

ai:нераспечатанный.note: Here of a fresh deck of cards; from распечатать 'to unseal'.

ai:нерасположение.note: Noun from нерасположенный; here glossed as 'dislike toward him'. The quoted line is a Polish-flavored phrase.

ai:нерасположенный.note: Instrumental plural нерасположенными, followed by к + dative.

ai:нерасчетливый.note: In text used as adverb нерасчетливо ('unwisely'); ё not written.

ai:несвязный.note: Short form несвязна; also neuter несвязное.

ai:несвязовать.note: Probably an analyzer error; the text form несвязуемое comes from the rare adjective несвязуемый ('unconnectable').

ai:несвязуемый.note: Rare, unusual word; from связывать 'to connect'; here of two contradictory sides of a character.

ai:несдобровать.note: Colloquial; used mostly with dative and future sense: ей несдобровать 'it would go badly for her'. Modern spelling: не сдобровать.

ai:несимпатичный.note: Short form несимпатичен ('was unappealing to him').

ai:нескорый.note: The text form нескоро is the adverb 'not soon, not quickly'; the analyzer's headword is only roughly right.

ai:неслышность.note: Here the soundlessness of her movements.

ai:несмертельный.note: Text form несмертелен is the short masculine form.

ai:несовместный.note: Text form несовместна is short feminine; standard word is несовместимый.

ai:несогбенно.note: Archaic/nonstandard; from несогбенный 'not bent' (cf. согнуть, stem согб-).

ai:несогбенный.note: Archaic/dialectal, from согнуть 'bend'; the text form несогбенно is adverbial.

ai:несоразмерный.note: Text form несоразмерно is adverbial: 'out of proportion with his age'.

ai:нестройный.note: Here of a disorderly, dysfunctional family.

ai:нестяжательный.note: Bookish; from стяжание 'acquisition'; short masculine form нестяжателен.

ai:несходный.note: Text forms: несходнее is comparative (more unlike); несходные is plural (differing from).

ai:несчастие.note: Older spelling of несчастье; к несчастию = 'unfortunately'.

ai:нетление.note: Church term: the saint's body not decaying.

ai:нетолковый.note: Text form нетолково is adverbial: 'tells it incoherently'.

ai:нетуть.note: Dialectal/colloquial peasant speech for нету/нет; here нетути.

ai:неусыпный.note: The text form неусыпно is adverbial.

ai:неутолимость.note: Here the grief's inability to be comforted.

ai:нещенсливый.note: Polish speaker's mangled Russian; from Polish nieszczęśliwy 'unfortunate', cf. щенсливый = szczęśliwy.

ai:нещечко.note: Affectionate dialectal form; here genitive нещечка; perhaps from ненаглядное сокровище.

ai:ни-ни.note: Emphatic colloquial refusal; here used before a French phrase.

ai:нибудь.note: Nonstandard separate spelling of для чего-нибудь ('for something/some reason'); the particle -нибудь is normally hyphenated.

ai:нибыть.note: Wrong headword; the text word is нибудь, spelled separately from чего-нибудь.

ai:низвердить.note: Wrong headword; correct verb is низвергнуть/низвергать. Text has short passive participle низвержен ('cast down').

ai:низверженный.note: Participle of низвергнуть; text form низвержен is the short masculine.

ai:низвержный.note: Wrong headword; text form низвержен is the short participle of низвергнуть.

ai:ниспровергнуть.note: Form in text is the perfective future 'ниспровергнут' (they will overthrow); bookish.

ai:ничесо.note: Church Slavonic form of 'ничто/ничего'; 'ничесо же ясти' = 'to eat nothing'. From a monastic rule text.

ai:ничесый.note: Wrong headword; the form is Church Slavonic 'ничесоже' (нич- 'ничто' + же), same as 'ничесо' here.

ai:нищенка.note: Feminine of нищий; dative here (подала нищенке = gave to a beggar woman).

ai:новешенький.note: Colloquial intensive form of новый; here genitive plural (also spelled новенький, новёхонький).

ai:новопреставившийся.note: Church/bookish participle (from новопреставиться); used of someone who has just died; here accusative singular masculine, animate.

ai:новопреставиться.note: Church Slavonic-style verb; 'новопреставившегося старца' = the elder who has just died (Zosima).

ai:норманочка.note: Diminutive of норманка (Norman woman, girl from Normandy); playful, affectionate.

ai:нотабена.note: From Latin 'nota bene'; here used as a noun meaning 'an important note/aside'. Same as нотабене.

ai:нотабене.note: From Latin 'nota bene' ('note well'); used as an indeclinable noun 'a noteworthy point/aside'.

ai:нравоучительный.note: 'нравоучительно' is the adverb (in a moralizing way); 'нравоучительное' is the neuter noun-like form (something with a moral).

ai:ну-тка.note: Colloquial/dialectal hortative, same as 'ну-ка' with the extra particle -тка.

ai:обагрить.note: Elevated/poetic; 'обагренные кровью' = stained with blood, 'обагрил руки кровью' = stained his hands with blood.

ai:обаятельница.note: Feminine of обаятель; affectionate/effusive address in a flirtatious speech.

ai:обвешать.note: Here in participle 'обвешанный крестами' = hung with (military) crosses.

ai:обворожитель.note: Masculine of обворожительница; genitive/accusative here (такого обворожителя = such a charmer).

ai:обделывать.note: Colloquial idiom 'обделывать делишки' = to handle one's (petty, often shady) business skillfully.

ai:обдорский.note: Adjective from Obdorsk, a remote northern Siberian settlement (now Salekhard); 'Обдорский монашек' = the little monk from Obdorsk.

ai:обдуманность.note: Legal sense in the trial speech: the crime was planned in advance.

ai:обеднение.note: Instrumental case here (с обеднением = with impoverishment).

ai:обер-офицер.note: Historical Russian military rank group (lieutenant to captain); from German Oberoffizier.

ai:обесславить.note: Here a participle 'обесславленное' = disgraced; close in meaning to 'опозоренное'.

ai:обетование.note: Church Slavonic/religious word for a solemn promise, e.g. God's promise; 'Земля обетованная' = the Promised Land.

ai:обещаться.note: Reflexive of обещать; in speech often 'обещался' = 'he promised (to do)'; slightly colloquial/dated.

g: to get used to a place
ai:обжиться.note: Here adverbial participle 'обжившись' = having settled in (Paris).

ai:обидчица.note: Feminine of обидчик; instrumental here (с ее обидчицей = with her offender).

ai:обинуясь.note: Archaic adverbial participle from обинуться; 'не обинуясь' = without hesitation, frankly.

ai:обличаться.note: Passive/reflexive of обличать; bookish; here 'to come to light, show itself'.

ai:облобызать.note: Archaic/elevated or ironic form of 'целовать'; облобызал = 'kissed'.

ai:обмазывать.note: Imperfective; here 'обмазывали лицо калом' = they smeared her face with excrement.

ai:обмерзнуть.note: Here participle 'обмерзший' = one covered with frost / half-frozen (passerby).

ai:обмочить.note: Perfective; 'обмочил лицо' = wet my face (with tears); 'обмочу полотенце' = I'll wet the towel.

ai:обнимала-целовать.note: Wrong headword; the text has the paired verbs 'обнимала-целовала' (I hugged and kissed) - from обнимать + целовать, both past feminine.

ai:обнимать-целовать.note: Paired verb combination (обнимать + целовать) written with a hyphen; here past feminine 'обнимала-целовала'.

ai:обнюхаться.note: Reflexive of обнюхать; used of dogs, and figuratively of people getting acquainted first.

ai:обнюхиваться.note: Imperfective of обнюхаться; used of dogs meeting.

ai:ободнять.note: Rare impersonal verb; 'ободняло' = day had broken; 'ободняв' = (adverbial participle) having settled into the day.

ai:ободриться.note: Perfective reflexive; 'ободрившись' = having taken heart, 'ободрюсь духом' = I shall take heart.

ai:ободряться.note: imperfective reflexive; forms in text: participle ободрявшиеся, 3sg ободряется

ai:обольститель-жених.note: hyphenated compound of обольститель (seducer) + жених (fiance); genitive form обольстителя-жениха

ai:обособление.note: in the text: something isolated from the whole, opposite of the general

ai:образок.note: diminutive of образ (icon); a small icon worn around the neck

ai:образок-то.note: образок + emphatic particle -то; correct headword образок

ai:обробел.note: colloquial; past masc. of оробеть with prefix об-, i.e. обробеть

ai:обругаться.note: colloquial; here Mitya/Ivan bursts out with a curse

ai:обрызгать.note: the form обрызжет is nonstandard/archaic; standard 3sg is обрызгает
