ai:обтираться.note: imperfective reflexive; обтираясь is the gerund

ai:обтяжка.note: dress detail: tight covering; here instrumental обтяжкою of fashionable dress

ai:обчищать.note: colloquial; imperfective, here about cleaning muddy galoshes

ai:обширность.note: here: breadth of the scope of church court's rights

ai:огадить.note: colloquial/vulgar; figuratively 'you have fouled my soul'

ai:оделить.note: perfective; also 'to endow (with gifts)' as in the second sentence

ai:одесную.note: archaic/Church Slavonic; here 'the robber crucified on the right'

ai:одеяльце.note: diminutive of одеяло; here instrumental одеяльцем

ai:один-одинешенек.note: colloquial intensified form of один; text spells it один-одинешенек

ai:одинешенький.note: colloquial intensive of один; here plural instrumental одинешенькими

ai:одиннадцатичасовый.note: here used as a noun modifier: the eleven-o'clock train

ai:одушевиться.note: perfective reflexive; одушевясь is an old-style gerund

ai:одушевление.note: here a state of lively inspiration

ai:ожениться.note: perfective; used of a man marrying

ai:ожесточаться.note: imperfective reflexive; ожесточаясь is the gerund

ai:ожидоветь.note: colloquial, derogatory antisemitic slur-stereotype meaning 'become like a miser'; period-typical; standard verb form is ожидоветь

ai:ожидовеять.note: analyzer error; correct headword ожидоветь; derogatory colloquial usage typical of the period

ai:озариться.note: perfective reflexive; often figurative, as in 'suddenly became clear'

ai:озаряться.note: imperfective reflexive; here 'his face lit up with joy'

ai:озирать.note: somewhat archaic/literary; озирая is the gerund; usually озираться (to look around)

ai:озлить.note: Perfective; here in the past tense (озлило, neuter, because the subject is a fact/circumstance).

ai:озреться.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic-flavored; here the imperative Озрись.

ai:окритиковать.note: Perfective, colloquial-ish; here the doctor sharply criticized the earlier treatment.

ai:окромя.note: Colloquial/dialectal form of кроме; here in the servant's speech (окромя того = besides that).

ai:окрыляться.note: Figurative, from крыло 'wing'; the self-esteem grows and takes wing as danger increases.

ai:омерзила.note: Analyzer's headword is wrong; the text form омерзил is from омерзить (masculine past tense).

ai:омерзить.note: Perfective; омерзить себя = to make oneself loathsome (in others' eyes) by an admission.

ai:омочить.note: Elevated/archaic-liturgical; imperative Омочи, here 'water the earth with your tears'.

ai:омрачиться.note: Perfective; used of a face that suddenly turns dark or gloomy.

ai:опамятоваться.note: Perfective, somewhat dated/colloquial; standard modern form is опомниться.

ai:опойковый.note: From опоек, the skin of an unweaned calf, used for fine soft boots; here a fashionable dandy's boots.

ai:оппонировать.note: Learned borrowing from Latin; here used ironically of a wife who liked to contradict her husband in small matters.

ai:опросчик.note: Rare word; here the person conducting the questioning (of Grigory), roughly the investigator.

ai:осалить.note: Colloquial, figurative; here 'sharply tarnished in reputation' (осаленным is a participle).

ai:осанисто.note: Adverb of осанистый; here with a self-important, dignified air.

ai:осанистый.note: From осанка 'bearing'; осанисто is the adverb, осанистым the instrumental form; here also with a hint of pomposity.

ai:освидетельствовать.note: Perfective; here a doctor examining a patient (освидетельствовав is a gerund).

ai:освободительница.note: Feminine of освободитель; here dative case (освободительнице).

ai:осердить.note: Dated/colloquial; here in a peasant driver's polite speech: 'so as not to make you angry'.

ai:осердиться.note: Dated/colloquial; Осердился на кого? = 'Got angry at someone, did you?'.

ai:оскорбитель.note: Someone who insults or offends another.

ai:оскорбленно-супружеский.note: Author's compound; 'offended-marital', i.e. feelings of a wronged husband.

ai:оскудевать.note: Imperfective, elevated style; here 'may repentance not dwindle in you'.

ai:ославить.note: Perfective, colloquial; from слава ('fame'), meaning to spread notoriety about someone.

ai:ославлять.note: Imperfective of ославить; here the imperative Ославляй.

ai:осьмиконечный.note: Church Slavonic form (modern: восьмиконечный); an eight-pointed Orthodox cross on a monk's cowl.

ai:осязаться.note: Passive/reflexive of осязать 'to feel by touch'; here 'a fragrance was distinctly sensed'.

ai:отверзть.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic (past отверз, participle отверзший); here 'opened (a book)', 'opened their mouths'.

ai:отверстый.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic participial form; отверсты = short plural 'are open' (the doors of paradise are open).

ai:отвертываться.note: Colloquial variant of отвёртываться/отворачиваться; here 'I turn away' when meeting someone.

ai:отворотиться.note: Perfective, colloquial; отворотясь is the gerund (having turned away).

ai:отговориться.note: Perfective; отговориться незнанием = to plead ignorance.

ai:отдавить.note: Perfective; отдавить ногу = to tread on someone's foot.

ai:отдернуться.note: Perfective; of a curtain, 'was drawn back'; of a person, 'flinched back'.

ai:отец-иезуит.note: Compound of отец + иезуит; here dative отцу-иезуиту, the confessor of a marquis (a Jesuit father-confessor).

ai:отирание.note: Church Slavonic-style verbal noun of отирать; here the ritual wiping of the monk being tonsured.

ai:откармливать.note: Imperfective; откармливаемый = being fattened (participle); here swine fattened for sale.

ai:откачнуться.note: Perfective; the text form is откачнулся.

ai:отколотить.note: Colloquial, perfective. Forms in text: отколочу, отколотил, отколотишь, отколотить.

ai:отколупывать.note: Colloquial, imperfective. Here it means to pick off a hundred rubles from the sewn-up sum.

ai:откулев.note: Dialectal/folksy form of откуда; the text has откулева.

ai:откулевый.note: Wrong headword; the text form откулева is a dialectal/folksy variant of откуда.

ai:отлепартовать.note: Servant's mangled/comic form, probably from рапортовать (to report), with a garbled prefix. Meaning is inferred from context.

g: to lift (of a weight on the heart)
ai:отлечь.note: Used in the idiom от сердца отлегло, 'a load was lifted from my heart'. Text form: отлегло.

ai:отмачивать.note: Colloquial slang sense (not 'to soak'): чудеса отмачивать = to work miracles. Imperfective.

ai:отмочить.note: Colloquial slang, perfective of отмачивать. отмочить штучку = pull off a stunt; 'я ему отмочил' = I shot back at him.

ai:отмстительно.note: Archaic/rare spelling; the standard form is мстительно. The analyzer's headword is the adverb itself.

ai:отмстительный.note: Archaic form of мстительный; the text has the adverb отмстительно.

ai:отмстить.note: Old spelling of отомстить. Forms in text: отмстил, отмстит, отмстить; in the quote 'отмщу' is the first-person future.

ai:отмщать.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic-style imperfective of отомстить. Text form: отмщающей (present active participle, genitive/dative feminine).

ai:отмщение.note: Elevated/archaic word, biblical flavor (as in 'Mine is vengeance').

ai:отниматься.note: Here in the sense of a body part losing feeling or mobility, e.g. поясница отнимается, 'the lower back seizes up'.

ai:отняться.note: Perfective; used of body parts losing function, e.g. отнялась поясница; у него отнялся язык = he was struck speechless.

ai:отомкнуть.note: Here it refers to unfastening the powder flask (рожок). Perfective.

ai:отомщать.note: Rare imperfective of отомстить. Text form: отомщавшая (past active participle, feminine), 'the woman who was taking revenge'.

ai:отпарировать.note: From French parer. Here 'to retort sharply' or 'to rebuff an accusation'.

ai:отписать.note: Two senses here: 'to write (back)', colloquial; and 'to transfer by will or deed' (все на себя отписать = sign everything over to herself).

ai:отпущаесать.note: Bad headword; the text form отпущаеши is Church Slavonic 'now lettest thou (thy servant) depart' (Nunc dimittis, Luke 2:29). The lemma would be отпущати; 'Ныне отпущаеши' is a liturgical quotation.

ai:отрезвить.note: Perfective, transitive; here the knocking sobered him.

ai:отрезвиться.note: Perfective, reflexive. Text forms: отрезвился, and the adverbial participle отрезвившись.

ai:отрекомендоваться.note: Somewhat formal or old-fashioned; perfective reflexive.

ai:отретироваться.note: From French se retirer; slightly jocular/colloquial, perfective.

ai:отрицаться.note: Here 'от + genitive' means to deny/disown, e.g. отрицаться от подписи = to deny one's signature. Imperfective reflexive.

ai:отроческий.note: Elevated word from отрок ('youth'). Text form: отроческим (instrumental).

ai:отрывочный.note: Text forms are the short feminine отрывочна and the comparative отрывочнее.

ai:отсекаться.note: Passive of отсекать; used here of a harmful member of society being cut off.

ai:отселе.note: Archaic/Church Slavonic form. Can be spatial ('from here') or temporal ('from now on').

ai:отселев.note: Wrong headword; the text form отселева is a dialectal/folksy variant of отсюда, as in 'three hundred versts from here'.

ai:отселевый.note: Wrong headword; the text form отселева is a dialectal/folksy variant of отсюда ('from here').

ai:отсмотреть.note: Colloquial/bureaucratic; here about the authorities inspecting (auditing) the sum. Form in text: отсмотрит (future).

ai:отсохнуть.note: Text form: the past active participle отсохшими ('withered legs').

ai:отступя.note: Adverbial participle (gerund) of отступить, 'to step back'; here отступя шаг = stepping back a pace.

ai:оттанцевать.note: perfective; here 'to dance the mazurka with someone'

ai:оттелев.note: dialectal/colloquial; text form оттелева = оттуда; the analyzer's headword is wrong

ai:оттелевый.note: wrong headword; the text form оттелева is a dialectal adverb meaning 'from there' (оттуда)

ai:оттенение.note: here: affected emphasis of syllables and sounds in speech

ai:оттереть.note: here: wipe blood from the face

ai:отторгнуться.note: отторгнувшихся = participle, 'those who have broken away from'

ai:оттудовый.note: wrong headword; оттудова is a colloquial/dialectal form of оттуда

ai:оттягать.note: colloquial; to take property from someone, here through lawsuits

ai:оттяпать-таки.note: оттяпать + colloquial particle -таки 'after all, in the end'; headword is not a real lemma

ai:отхихикнуться.note: colloquial; perfective, reflexive-like form of the reply

g: to draw back in a wave

ai:отцу-иезуит.note: wrong headword; text is 'духовному отцу-иезуиту', dative of отец-иезуит

ai:отчеканивать.note: here: speaking clearly, with each word sharply distinct

ai:отшедший.note: archaic/church-Slavonic style participle of отойти; отшедший с земли = departed from earth

ai:отъединенный.note: the text form отъединенно is the adverb of this adjective

ai:отыать.note: wrong headword; отымешь is from отымать/отнять (archaic/colloquial form of отнимать)

ai:парадоксалист.note: One who habitually voices paradoxical opinions.

ai:патер.note: From Latin pater; used for Catholic priests.

ai:патетическа.note: Wrong headword; correct lemma is патетически.

g: to run over one by one

ai:переделаться.note: Here 'to turn oneself into a Frenchman'.

ai:перемежка.note: с перемежками = 'with intervals, on and off'.

ai:по-институтски.note: Refers to the manners of girls from a genteel women's institute (finishing school).

ai:по-казенному.note: казенный = state/official; implies formal, impersonal or stilted wording.

ai:по-карамазовски.note: Coined by Dostoevsky from the family name Karamazov.

ai:по-лютерански.note: Refers to Lutheran (Protestant) views, seen as more 'enlightened' about hell.

ai:по-модному.note: Variant of по-модному/по-модному 'fashionably'; also used as a fashion/modernity marker.

ai:побый.note: Wrong headword; the form побой is genitive plural of побои 'beatings'.

ai:поверстаться.note: Perfective reflexive, from верста; here 'they drew level side by side'.

ai:поверять.note: Imperfective of поверить in the sense 'to confide'; usually spelled поверять.

ai:повивальный.note: Used in повивальная бабка/бабушка = midwife (old term).

ai:погордиться.note: Perfective with по-; here the need to show pride.

ai:подаянный.note: Derived from подаяние; подаянные грошики = pennies received as alms.

ai:подгребать.note: Imperfective; here to rake coals to the pyre.

ai:поделом.note: Often used as a predicate: 'поделом ему' = it serves him right.

ai:подмарывание.note: Verbal noun from подмарывать (imperfective of подмарать); the text has the instrumental plural.

ai:подновить.note: Text has the participle подновленный: 'in a renewed guise'.

ai:подплясывать.note: Colloquial; to dance in accompaniment to something, e.g. a song refrain.

ai:подпрыгивание.note: Verbal noun from подпрыгивать; the text has the prepositional plural.

ai:подсоблять.note: Colloquial/dialectal variant of подсоблять, related to подсобить; used in a lower-class speaker's voice.

ai:подтибрить.note: Slang/colloquial; to steal quietly or make off with something.

ai:подхватывание.note: Verbal noun from подхватывать; here catching infants on a bayonet.

ai:познавание.note: Somewhat bookish verbal noun from познавать; genitive here.

ai:позубоскалить.note: Colloquial; from зубоскалить, to crack jokes or tease.

g: trimmed with gold or silver braid

ai:полечить.note: Perfective 'to treat for a while'; here 'I can now get my family medical treatment'.

ai:полковница.note: Feminine term for the wife of a colonel.

ai:полминутка.note: Diminutive of полминуты; the text has the accusative and genitive forms.

ai:полнотелый.note: Describes a woman of fleshy, well-rounded figure.

ai:половинный.note: Here 'half-hearted': Alyosha rejects a half-way compromise.

ai:поломоечка.note: Diminutive of поломойка (a woman who washes floors), a cleaning woman.

ai:полоскательный.note: Used in полоскательная чашка: a rinsing bowl, e.g. for rinsing the mouth.

ai:полрюмочка.note: Diminutive of полрюмки; the text form полрюмочки is genitive.

ai:полсекунды.note: Genitive of полсекунды, used with с первой... as 'from the first half-second'.

ai:полулист.note: Used in the phrase 'на полулисте' = on a half-sheet.

ai:полуоткрыть.note: Here in the past tense: she half-opened her lips.

ai:полушелковый.note: Describes the old upholstery of the furniture.

ai:польститься.note: Takes на + accusative: польститься на деньги = be tempted by money.

ai:полюбезничать.note: Colloquial; first-person future 'I'll play the charmer'.

ai:полюбовно.note: Used with settling disputes: покончить споры полюбовно.

ai:полюбовный.note: Analyzer's guess; the text form is the adverb полюбовно.

ai:померзнуть.note: Form померзших is a participle: 'frozen, frost-bitten' flowers.

ai:помещица.note: Feminine of помещик; a woman who owns an estate.

ai:попомнить.note: Often a warning: 'you'll remember this'; попомни! = mark my words.
